title: Photo 079 · 아워글래스 SSBBW · 알레브리헤 · 걸터앉기 3/4 · 흑인 40대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bare gallery space with a plain smooth mid-grey wall behind her, nothing in the frame but a single backless bench carved from a solid block of pale grey stone, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Black woman in her late 40s, faint lines at the eyes and mouth, deep near-black skin tone, THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, void complexion, not brown, not lightened, her face exactly as dark as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, waist-length locs with gold cuffs, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears oversized round studs and has long square nails.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that it overflows the stone bench on both sides and is cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — a shadowed groove running around her middle, the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight and reaching down between her knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds as it falls, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline and far wider than her shoulders, a gigantic rounded rear, gigantic soft thighs pressing together down to the knees, huge soft calves, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Wide at the bust, drawn in at the waistline, wide again below: the silhouette reads as a great hourglass at the most extreme size. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is softer and looser at this age, each fold hanging lower and settling further over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it settles, spreads and presses down against the hard stone beneath her.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a coarser surface grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, crepey texture in the deepest folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Oaxacan alebrije style — her own skin tone as the base colour, densely painted with vivid neon magenta, yellow, lime green, turquoise and orange dots, stripes, zigzags and small flowers, a bright striped band following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs, no animal figures. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Seated on the backless stone bench with her hips turned about 45 degrees away from the camera so the great curve of her rear and one hip spreading out on the stone is seen from the side, her torso twisted back toward the lens and her face turned to the camera, the great mass of her middle settling forward over her thighs seen at an angle, her near knee toward the camera and her far leg angled away, one hand resting back on the bench behind her hip and the other resting on her near thigh, both arms held clear of her body so nothing crosses in front of her torso, her feet flat on the floor, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge of the bench presses into them, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme magenta crisscross strap platform stiletto sandals, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the neon colours blazing, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
